items.title: Bimuelos with Honey
items.alt: Golden fried dough puffs sit on a turquoise floral plate beside a honey jar, wooden dipper and berry-red napkin.
items.description: A thin glossy drizzle coats the irregular golden dough puffs. The turquoise floral plate, clear honey jar and wooden dipper gather above a folded red napkin with a small stitched edge.

items.title: Oil Cruse Beside a Story Book
items.alt: A painted ceramic oil cruse and its lid sit beside an open book with an oil-jar illustration and a small olive branch.
items.description: Blue-and-gold leaf decoration wraps the cream ceramic jug, with amber-colored oil visible at the open rim. Its separate lid and an olive branch sit beside a blank open book carrying a small jar drawing.

items.title: Velvet Kippah with a Book and Dreidel
items.alt: A royal-blue velvet kippah with gold embroidery rests beside a plum-colored book, a wooden dreidel and gold chocolate coins.
items.description: Gold seams and geometric embroidery trace the domed blue velvet cap. A closed plum book with a pale ribbon bookmark lies behind the small dreidel and two foil-wrapped coins.

items.title: Blue Leaf Wreath with Stars of David
items.alt: A circular wreath of blue and ivory leaves carries silver six-pointed stars, round beads and a blue ribbon bow.
items.description: Folded leaves in royal blue, turquoise and ivory build a full circular ring. Silver Star of David ornaments and glossy beads sit among the leaves, with a blue bow below and a hanging loop above.

items.title: Felt Dreidel and Star Garland
items.alt: A curved blue cord carries stitched blue felt dreidels, ivory Stars of David and round silver beads, with loops at both ends.
items.description: Blue felt dreidels with gold leafy stitching alternate with ivory star ornaments along the hanging cord. Silver beads separate the pieces, and both blue end loops remain visible beyond the ornaments.

items.title: Hanukkah Paper Craft Materials
items.alt: Blue and cream paper, a six-pointed star cutout, a paper dreidel, scissors, glue and silver thread rest on a craft board beside candles.
items.description: A folded paper dreidel stands among loose cream and blue sheets on the tan work board. A star-shaped cutout, blue-handled scissors, glue stick and spool of silver thread surround the small lit candleholder.
